assets.name: modern-wallpaper
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original 16:9 desktop wallpaper for a modern macOS-inspired personal portfolio. Create a sophisticated polished abstract wallpaper: broad flowing translucent curved ribbons and satin glass surfaces, saturated cobalt and lavender transitioning into warm coral-peach, soft luminous edges, sculptural organic depth, subtle restrained light. Calm bright central negative space behind translucent windows, dramatic color concentrated around left and right edges. Full-bleed landscape 1920 by 1080 composition, premium modern Apple desktop sensibility, no text, no logos, no UI, no icons, no watermark.

assets.name: classic-wallpaper
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original 16:9 wallpaper for an early 2010 Mac OS X-inspired desktop. A breathtaking deep violet and midnight-blue spiral galaxy in a crisp dark star field, glowing ivory galactic core offset above center, soft magenta cosmic dust sweeping diagonally from lower left to upper right, elegant understated photographic astronomy, rich natural depth with plenty of quiet dark areas for silver desktop windows. Evoke the beautiful space-themed Snow Leopard/Lion era without copying an existing wallpaper. Full-bleed wide landscape 1920 by 1080, no text, no logos, no UI, no icons, no watermark.

assets.name: modern-finder
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: transparent dock application icon for a modern macOS-inspired desktop. One front-facing blue-and-white friendly Finder-style face on a perfectly proportioned rounded square, right half very pale blue-white, left half rich sky blue, a subtle smooth curved vertical dividing line, minimalist navy eyes and curved smile. Contemporary polished soft three-dimensional app icon with satin highlights, restrained shallow bevel, confident simple geometry readable at 32px. Center exactly in a square canvas with equal transparent padding all around, icon occupies 84 percent of width. Genuine transparent background, no words, no extra objects, no cast shadow outside the square, no watermark.

assets.name: classic-finder
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: transparent dock application icon for a Mac OS X 2010-inspired desktop. Genuine transparent background, no text, no words, no extra objects, no exterior cast shadow, no watermark.
